Espresso Flavoured
Field Notes

Welcome! This world is a little kinder to builders, so you can spend less time worrying and more time making something you love.

- Gabby

Your Safe Haven

Crouch and use a bed with an empty hand to make it your home. Monsters won't spawn within 32 blocks of it.

Sleeping elsewhere won't move it. Break the bed and the protection goes. Only a night at home leaves you truly rested.

Builds Stay Built

Creepers still bite, but their blasts no longer break blocks.

Endermen leave your walls alone, and phantoms never visit, so rest whenever you like.

Coffee Corner

Roast coffee cherries, then brew them in an espresso machine on a coffee bar. Mugs are fired clay.

Away two days? Only your own bed leaves you rested. Decaf helps you sleep well.

Bean Coins

Every advancement in the Espresso Flavoured tab pays you a Bean Coin.

A master barista (a villager with an espresso machine) takes them: eight buy the Golden Mug, and one or two buy a treat.

Café Charms

A master barista sells a charm or two for Bean Coins, and they turn up in café and village chests.

Wear them in your trinket slots: a Lucky Bean, a Thermos, a Pocket Hearth and more, each with a small perk.

If You Fall

Your hotbar, armour and off-hand stay with you. In the Espresso Flavoured pack, the rest waits in a grave where you fell. Head back, open it, and carry on.

Happy building!
